actions.rationale: Receive MX CRAH27 / CORRA_2027-03 at the packet implied 3.13. That is the first 2027 three-month contract that prices a Canadian hiking cycle (+84bp vs CORRA cash 2.29) after 1m CORRA still only reaches 2.58 by Dec-2026 and Dec-26 3m CRAZ26 is 2.775. August labor (-42k, wages +2.0%) and CPI-trim/median 1.9/2.0 do not support delivering that 2027 path. Side long is duration-long in implied-rate space (profits if the 3.13 implied falls toward the still-alive near-term path).

events.invalidation: BoC delivers or endorses the priced 2027 CRA path, Canadian core/labor reheat, or CORRA_2027-03 implied stays at/above 3.13 as catch-up is realized. Energy headlines without core/labor confirmation do not kill the trade.

events.thesis: Fade the 2027 CORRA hiking cycle. Markets price 84-130.5bp of Canadian hikes into 2027 while the tradable 1m path is still nearly on hold and Canadian core/labor already argue against catch-up. Express that as long-duration CORRA_2027-03. Do not take conflicted US SR3, AONIA meeting-binary, or FX overlays on this freeze.
